description: Demographic narratives become dehumanizing and enable coercive or exclusionary policy.
Climate stress drives displacement housing pressure protection gaps and urban absorption stress.
Aging and care demand overwhelm unpaid families underpaid workers and weak care systems.
Exclusion increases irregularity deaths exploitation informal labor and polarization.
Large youth cohorts face unemployment housing barriers weak education and limited voice.
Migrant care workers carry aging-society needs without rights wages or family protections.
Legal pathways and integration reforms underperform because local capacity and finance lag.
Inclusive urban demographic renewal is weakened by insufficient housing and service finance.
